test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the foreign trade by two countries A and B in 5 different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c70b10e1ba9d415f6336c1a36e12fa909ba021aec6df00f4ef6cde6deedfe227.png] 

J1 = The total foreign trade by country A in all the 5 years.

J2 = The total foreign trade by country B in all the 5 years.

What is the value of (J2 - J1)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

J1 = The total foreign trade by country A in all the 5 years. = 170 + 150 + 75 + 65 + 35 = 495

J2 = The total foreign trade by country B in all the 5 years. = 45 + 105 + 195 + 175 + 90 = 610

J2 - J1 = 610 - 495 = 115

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
